title: Our Trail Camera Caught What Came Back From the Woods #shorts #scarystories
description:
She came back with the firewood. She just wasn't Tess anymore.

Follow for new scary stories every day.

#scarystory #foundfootage #creepy #shorts

beats.text: Three of us went camping at Hollow Pine Lake. Only two of us came home.
It was me, my brother Owen, and our friend Tess.
Owen strapped a trail camera to a tree to catch deer.
Near midnight, Tess walked off to find firewood.
Ten minutes later, she came back with empty arms, smiling.
She said she got lost. She didn't seem scared at all.
That night, I heard her whispering outside the tent. In Owen's voice.
By morning, Owen just laughed it off.
But Tess never ate. She never blinked, not even when the fire popped.
The second night, we checked the trail camera.
At 12:03, it showed Tess walking into the trees.
At 12:04, something else walked out. Tall and thin, wearing her jacket.
Then it stopped, and turned its head to look right at the camera.
Behind us, Tess asked why we were watching the camera.
Owen grabbed the keys, and we ran.
I heard her running behind us. On all fours.
We locked ourselves in the car.
Then her face pressed flat against my window.
Owen floored it, and she was gone.
Rangers found the real Tess two days later, asleep under a fallen pine.
beats.card: AUG 11 2024: MISSING CAMPER FOUND ALIVE. NO MEMORY OF THE LAST TWO DAYS.

beats.text: She'd been there since the first night. The thing had spent a whole day learning how we talk.
Last week, Owen hung that trail camera on our porch.
At 12:04 last night, it filmed Owen walking out into the woods.
Owen was asleep upstairs the whole night.
This morning, he came down for breakfast smiling. He hasn't blinked once.
